##### Project General Facts

Ocean Star is a masterpiece of luxury living, nestled within the prestigious Rashid Yachts & Marina, where the soothing sounds of the water and the vibrant pulse of the city converge in perfect harmony. This exquisite development embodies the essence of refined living, blending the serene charm of a waterfront community with the dynamic, cosmopolitan spirit of Dubai, seamlessly combining opulence, comfort, and the tranquil surroundings of the marina. With a health clinic ideally situated within the property and a school just steps away, residents of Ocean Star enjoy unparalleled convenience and peace of mind.

The allure of Ocean Star lies in its meticulously curated assortment of lifestyle and wellness amenities, each designed to nurture the body and soul. The development features a breathtaking signature canal pool, reminiscent of the world's most exclusive resorts, where residents can unwind and rejuvenate. Lush gardens offer a peaceful retreat, blending the city's energy with the calm of nature, while sports and recreational amenities are tailored for enjoyment and relaxation, making Ocean Star the epitome of comfort and elegant living. Every aspect of the development reflects a deep appreciation for the finer things in life, elevating each day into an extraordinary experience.

The interiors of Ocean Star boast modern finishing with high-quality materials, complemented by equipped kitchens that cater to the most discerning residents. With a variety of homes to choose from, each with its unique appeal, residents can select from spacious one-bedroom suites, ideal for singles or couples, or larger two- and three-bedroom units, featuring en-suite bathrooms, ample wardrobe space, and expansive balconies with direct views of the linear pool, ensuring the utmost comfort and luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

Mina Rashid is a haven of luxury and beauty, where the majestic Rashid Yachts & Marina stands as a global destination for discerning individuals. This elegant environment combines the ultimate modern waterfront architecture with a sophisticated blend of luxury residences, a full-service marina, and an appealing mix of restaurants and shops. The marina at Mina Rashid offers convenient access to Dubai, with state-of-the-art facilities, an expert multilingual team, and a range of amenities and services. Residents of Mina Rashid can indulge in the beauty and luxury of this captivating destination, relaxation and exploration are just a stone's throw away from Dubai's most exciting attractions.

The area surrounding Mina Rashid is a treasure trove of exciting local hotspots, waiting to be discovered and explored. With its beautiful scenery, modern amenities, and access to a range of activities, Mina Rashid is the perfect place to unwind and rejuvenate. The marina's flexible berthing options, accommodating yachts of various sizes, make it an ideal destination for yacht owners and enthusiasts alike. As a luxurious residential haven, Mina Rashid offers the perfect blend of relaxation, exploration, and excitement, making it a truly unique and captivating destination.

Mina Rashid's proximity to Dubai's most exciting attractions makes it an ideal location for those who crave the thrill of the city. With its state-of-the-art facilities, elegant environment, and range of amenities and services, Mina Rashid is a haven of luxury and beauty, where residents can indulge in the finer things in life. The area's beautiful scenery, modern amenities, and access to exciting local hotspots make it the perfect place to relax, explore, and enjoy the vibrant spirit of Dubai.
